# 2 Clement — Chapter 3 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 3
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. God has shown us extraordinary mercy. Above all: we who are alive no longer sacrifice to gods that are dead, and we no longer worship them. Through Christ we have come to know the Father of truth. So what does it mean to truly know him? It means not denying the one through whom we came to know him.
2. Jesus himself said: "Whoever acknowledges me before others, I will acknowledge before my Father."
3. This is our way of repaying him — acknowledging the one through whom we were saved.
4. But how do we acknowledge him? By living out what he says, by not disobeying his commands, by honoring him not just with our words but with our whole heart and mind.
5. He speaks of this very thing in Isaiah: "This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."
